title: Each hand-written technical record of Delivering fills exactly one slot
when: Reads the spec at the commit under test with the pinned Lathe and lists each technical record of ST-DLV that no tooling record generates and nothing provides, with the slots it fills.
then: Expects each such record to fill exactly one slot of ST-PAT-GO-CODE, and the spec check to report no pattern-not-followed finding for ST-DLV.
notes: The ID T05 is the position of Delivering among the domains, so that the test plans of other domains, written at the same time, take other IDs.

title: Each hand-written technical record of Extending fills exactly one slot of the Go code pattern
when: Load STEGO's spec at the commit under test with the Lathe version that STEGO pins, and read the slot fillings (data/fills.jsonl) of each technical record of ST-EXT that no tooling record generates and nothing provides.
then: Expects each such record of ST-EXT to fill exactly one slot of ST-PAT-GO-CODE, and names each record that fills none or more than one.
notes: Not automated yet: no test reads the slot fillings. A record with no filling and a record with two fillings are the two faults; the test lists both kinds, not only the first one it finds. lathe check --json does not print the fillings, so the test reads them from the data.

title: Each fill of Delivering serves an essential record
when: Reads the spec at the commit under test with the pinned Lathe and lists each fill of ST-DLV.
then: Expects each fill to implement, build or sit under an essential record, and the spec check to report no accidental-not-accounted-for finding for ST-DLV.
notes: Today the check reports ST-DLV-CH01, ST-DLV-CH02, ST-DLV-REPO01, ST-DLV-REPO02, ST-DLV-REPO03 and ST-DLV-REPO05, so the test fails until they are put under the records they serve. The ID T05 is the position of Delivering among the domains, so that the test plans of other domains, written at the same time, take other IDs.

title: Each fill of the Go code pattern in Extending serves an essential record, and no Go file of Extending serves none
when: Load STEGO's spec at the commit under test with the Lathe version that STEGO pins. For each record of ST-EXT that fills a slot of ST-PAT-GO-CODE, follow its implements link or its parent. Then list the Go files of the packages that the technical records of ST-EXT name.
then: Expects each such record to implement, build or sit under an essential record of STEGO, and each Go file in those packages to be named by such a record.
notes: Not automated yet: no test follows the fillings to essential records. The scan of Go files catches code that a record does not name, which the rule says to remove.

title: Each file of a Delivering fill meets each rule of the code standard for its kind
when: Runs each rule check of the code standard test (ST-STD-CODE-R01 to ST-STD-CODE-R06) over the files that the fills of ST-DLV name, at the commit under test.
then: Expects no fault of any rule in those files, and no entry for them in the committed list of known faults.
notes: Uses the rule checks of internal/assure that the standard rule tests ST-STD-CODE-R01-T01 to ST-STD-CODE-R06-T01 run, limited to the files of ST-DLV. The ID T05 is the position of Delivering among the domains, so that the test plans of other domains, written at the same time, take other IDs.

title: Each file of Extending meets every rule of the code standard that applies to its kind
when: Run the code standard check of internal/assure over the files that the technical records of ST-EXT name, at the commit under test.
then: Expects no fault of any rule of ST-STD-CODE for those files outside the committed list of known faults (ST-ASR-TOOL03) at the same commit, and no listed fault for those files that the tree no longer has.
notes: Not automated yet: the code standard tests (ST-STD-CODE-R01-T01 and the others) read the whole tree, not one domain. This test is the same check limited to the files of ST-EXT, so a fault shows by its domain.
